regions.label: Start
regions.note: Points SI at the script and switches to EGA graphics, 640 by 350 in 16 colors.

regions.label: Header reader
regions.note: Copies the line's 5 header bytes into the player's own instructions, then reads where the line starts.

regions.label: Command decoder
regions.note: Reads one script byte: a stroke, or x, w, y and { for left, right, new line and end of picture.

regions.label: End of frame
regions.note: Asks DOS if a key is waiting. If not, adds 1 to the ink byte inside his code and draws line 3 again.

regions.label: Stroke drawer
regions.note: Paints each pixel of a stroke through the BIOS, then its shadow 2 right and 2 down.

regions.label: Key pressed
regions.note: A key ends the show: text mode, then the exit code.

regions.label: Script, line 1
regions.note: محافظة بورسعيد: header 4B 43 00 07 04, 340 strokes, gray with a red shadow.

regions.label: Script, line 2
regions.note: مركز المعلومات و التوثيق: header 4B 43 0D 0E 0E, 476 strokes in yellow.

regions.label: Script, line 3
regions.note: إدارة الحاسب الآلى: header 4B 43 0D 03 0E, 319 strokes, drawn again in a new color every frame. Ends with {.

regions.label: End byte z
regions.note: z, the end command of his next player, the one in TAHER and DEMO.COM.

regions.label: Exit
regions.note: Text mode, his credit printed by DOS, then back to DOS.

regions.label: Credit
regions.note: "K E M Y A M Software Corp., <C>1991 YASSER MOHAMED ALI." in plain text.

regions.label: More script bytes
regions.note: 10 more bytes of x commands and strokes after his credit.

routines.name: read_header
routines.note: Writes each line's settings into the player's own code.

lines.note: The opcode for x goes to 013B
The opcode for w goes to 0143
x: one column (the header wrote this opcode)
Is a key waiting? INT 21h, AH=0Bh
The next ink, inside the code

The shadow switch, from the header
